title: Notes HTTP API
summary: A tiny JSON HTTP API that keeps notes in memory, served as a WSGI application from the standard library.

requirements.title: Create and read notes over HTTP
requirements.description: notesapi.app.make_app() returns a new WSGI application with an empty store of its own. POST /notes with a JSON object {"text": ...} creates a note with the next integer id, from 1; GET /notes/<id> reads one note and GET /notes lists every note in the order they were created. Every answer with a body is JSON, with the header Content-Type: application/json.

criteria.when: POST /notes is sent with the JSON body {"text": "buy milk"}
criteria.then: it answers status 201, Content-Type application/json and the body {"id": 1, "text": "buy milk"}

criteria.given: an application where the note "buy milk" was created
criteria.then: it answers status 200 and the body {"id": 1, "text": "buy milk"}

criteria.given: an application where the notes "a" and then "b" were created
criteria.then: it answers status 200 and the body [{"id": 1, "text": "a"}, {"id": 2, "text": "b"}]

requirements.title: Delete a note over HTTP
requirements.description: DELETE /notes/<id> removes the note; its id is never given to another note.

criteria.given: an application where the note with id 1 exists
criteria.then: it answers status 204 with an empty body, and a GET /notes/1 sent afterwards answers status 404

requirements.title: Refuse bad requests with a JSON error
requirements.description: A request the API cannot serve is answered with a 4xx status and a JSON object holding an "error" key with a message, and changes nothing in the store.

criteria.given: a body that is not JSON, or a JSON body without a non-empty string "text"
criteria.then: it answers status 400 with a JSON object holding "error", and GET /notes still answers []

criteria.given: an application with no note of id 99
criteria.then: it answers status 404 with a JSON object holding "error"

criteria.given: a path the API does not serve, such as /other, or a method /notes does not allow, such as PUT
criteria.then: the unknown path answers status 404 and the method answers status 405, each with a JSON object holding "error"

quality.target: 100 POST requests followed by 100 GET requests through the WSGI callable take under 1 second
a request body over 65536 bytes is refused with status 413 before it is parsed

constraints: Python 3.11 or later, standard library only (wsgiref and json); no web framework.
The package is notesapi/ at the project root: notesapi/store.py defines the in-memory NoteStore, notesapi/app.py defines make_app(store=None).
The application is a plain WSGI callable; tests call it directly with a constructed environ, without opening a socket.
Tests live in tests/ and run with pytest from the project root.
